scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 您攜帶的物品太多了。 -
- 請減輕負重後再試。 -

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
Let's show the power of the Guillaume Army to those stinky Croixs!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
讓那些克魯瓦的臭傢伙見識一下吉約姆軍團的力量！

scripts.text: I want to join your army!
scripts.translation: 加入軍隊

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
I'm very pleased that you want to join us and fight the Croix Army, but I'm sorry: I can't send a rookie like you to die on the cruel battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
很高興你願意加入我們，對抗克魯瓦軍團。
不過，你還是個新手，我不能送你去殘酷的戰場上送死。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
I'm very pleased that you want to join us and fight the Croix Army, but I'm sorry: I can't send a rookie like you to die on the cruel battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
You seem to have just returned from the battlefield.
It's too early for you to go back. Go rest, and leave the enemies to us!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
你似乎剛從戰場回來，現在就返回還太早了。
去休息一下，把敵人交給我們！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
I've received a report informing me that an elite corps has been dispatched to the battlefield fighting the Croixs already.
Why don't you go wait for a while? I suggest you sharpen your weapons and prepare your supplies until then.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
據報告，精銳部隊已經出征，正在戰場上對抗克魯瓦軍團。
請先等一會兒，趁這段時間磨好武器、備足補給。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
An elite corps is already standing by to be dispatched to the battlefield.
Why don't you go wait for a while? I suggest you sharpen your weapons and prepare your supplies until then.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
精銳部隊已經集結，正在等待出征。
請先等一會兒，趁這段時間磨好武器、備足補給。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
You definitely seem to be ready for battle!
Go show the Croixs what fear truly means!
Today, our cry of victory shall echo all over the battlefield!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
看來你已經準備好戰鬥了！
去讓克魯瓦軍團見識什麼叫恐懼！
今天，我們勝利的吶喊將響徹戰場！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Army Officer]
Today, we shall be victorious!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆軍官]
今天，我們將取得勝利！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
The objective of the Flavius Battle is to score 2 points before your enemy by destroying their crystal.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
瀑拉畢烏斯戰役的目標是摧毀敵方天使彩蛋，搶先獲得2分。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
The crystals for both armies are protected by special barricades that cannot be destroyed by direct attacks.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
雙方的天使彩蛋都受特殊路障保護，直接攻擊無法摧毀這些路障。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
But they can be removed by destroying the Guardians that protect the enemy army base.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
不過，擊敗守護敵方基地的守衛，就能移除路障。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
The crystals are immune to every type of skill; your physical attacks are the only choice for destroying your enemy's crystal.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
天使彩蛋免疫所有技能，只能用普通物理攻擊摧毀。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
If you are ready, start by clicking the ^0000FFbattle button from the interface^000000.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
準備好後，請點選^0000FF介面上的戰鬥按鈕^000000開始。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
Please remember: when you join a battle, you will be receiving a token which indicates the set duration for which you cannot participate in the same type of battle.
You may check the duration by pressing the Alt+U keys.
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
參加戰鬥後，你會獲得一個標記，顯示再次參加同類戰鬥所需等待的時間。
按Alt+U可以檢視。

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
Please bear in mind once you cancel, ^0000FFyou may not reapply for 1 minute^000000!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
請注意，取消申請後，^0000FF1分鐘內不能重新申請^000000！

scripts.text:
[Guillaume Knight]
Are you ready for battle? Then apply with the recruiter next to me!
scripts.translation:
[吉約姆騎士]
準備好戰鬥了嗎？
去找我旁邊的招募員報名吧！
